meta.title: Optimize WhatsApp media loading
meta.body_summary: Implement paged file listing, lazy loading, and lightweight directory summaries in WhatsApp media UI to improve loading performance.

perf_labels.notes: Codex PR merged without review; paging and lazy-loading optimize WhatsApp media loading but lack benchmark evidence; low collaboration.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 367 changed lines across 17 files, this is a small-to-medium sized refactor by absolute volume. It aligns with a modular incremental performance PR and merged quickly without review, consistent with a low-collaboration repository.

core_change_summary.description: Introduce paged file listing and lazy loading for WhatsApp media: lightweight DirectorySummary, GetWhatsAppMediaFilesUseCase, lazy LoadFiles event in UI, and on-demand file fetch for cleaning.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Multiple analyzer/scanner files updated to use new FileEntry lightweight model; folder selection and empty tab handling fixes also included.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: paging implementation for WhatsApp media with new use case, DI wiring.
Introduced lightweight FileEntry and updated scanner/analyzer models for lazy loading.
Fixed compilation errors for FileEntry usage across screens.
Removed unused clipboard and streak preferences; fixed folder selection toggle and empty tab handling.
All commits by same maintainer; no review iterations.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened by maintainer with 7 commits; merged ~4 hours later by same maintainer without any review or comments.
